resources.string: Connect to a host to open a terminal. Files sit under the terminal, and monitoring sits beside it when the window is wide enough.
Open sessions stay connected while this app is in the background. A notification stays visible. A session ends when you close it, or when the system force-stops the app.
Some phone makers still stop background apps. If a session drops after you leave the app, allow unrestricted battery use, autostart, and background activity for OpenFinalShell in system settings.
